line.description: The spread or total line predicted against, as a decimal string, e.g. '-3.5' or '47.5'. Integers only in lexicons, so strings carry halves.

team.description: com.professorbutts.sports.team record predicted to win (winner), or to cover (spread).

total.description: total kind: combined points. Paired with over/under when a line is given.

margin.description: margin kind: winning margin in points, with team as the winner.

person.description: com.professorbutts.sports.person record (finish kind, or winner of an individual event).

contest.description: Optional com.professorbutts.sports.contest this counts toward. Without it, the prediction still counts on open leaderboards.

position.description: finish kind: predicted finishing position of person. 1 = wins.

overUnder.description: total or spread kind, when predicting against a line instead of an exact number.

subjectCid.description: Optional CID of the subject version the fan saw. Game records are rewritten in place, so graders use the uri; this is for display and audit only.

main.description: Recommended key: '<subject rkey>-<kind>' (finish: '<subject rkey>-finish-<person rkey>'), so a fan has one prediction per subject and kind. Any key is accepted; if several exist, the newest counts.

score.description: Exact final score of both teams.

total.description: Combined points, exact or over/under a line.

finish.description: Where a person finishes in an event (golf, racing).

margin.description: Winning team and margin of victory.

spread.description: Which team covers a point spread.

description: One fan's prediction about one game or event, kept in their own repo: who wins, the final score, the combined total, the margin, the winner against a spread, or a finishing position (golf, racing). One record per subject per kind (finish: per person). Counts only if an indexer saw it before the subject starts; graded when final.
